name: instagram_list_conversations
description: Conversations in the account's Instagram inbox, most recently updated first: { data: [{ id, updated_time }], paging }. This is how you find who has written to the account, which matters because a DM may only be sent to someone who messaged first — a person with no conversation here cannot be messaged at all. Pass --user_id with an Instagram-scoped id to get just the one conversation with that person. Feed an id to instagram_get_conversation for its messages.

user_id.description: Instagram-scoped id (IGSID) of one person, to return only the conversation with them. Omit to list all of them.
